component.name: Warpdown
component.summary: Fast download manager with browser integration

description.p: Warpdown is a free, open-source alternative to Internet Download Manager. It splits downloads into several connections, resumes them after interruptions and takes over downloads from Firefox and Chrome.

ul.li: Fast, resumable downloads with category folders
Video sites through yt-dlp, HLS streams and subtitles
Scheduler, speed limits, automatic retry and checksum verification
